description: This file contains Redux action creators and utility functions for handling global actions in the Mattermost web application, including channel switching, user typing events, logout, and team/channel redirection logic.

methods.name: emitChannelClickEvent
methods.description: Handles channel click events, switching to the selected channel, updating local storage, and dispatching relevant Redux actions.

methods.name: setLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Sets the last unread status for a given channel based on message counts and user membership.

methods.name: clearLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Redux action object to clear the last unread channel information.

methods.name: updateNewMessagesAtInChannel
methods.description: Updates the last viewed timestamp for a channel.

methods.name: emitCloseRightHandSide
methods.description: Dispatches action to close the right-hand side panel.

methods.name: showMobileSubMenuModal
methods.description: Opens a modal with menu elements for mobile view.

methods.name: sendEphemeralPost
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an ephemeral post message in a channel.

methods.name: sendAddToChannelEphemeralPost
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an ephemeral post indicating a user was added to a channel.

methods.name: emitLocalUserTypingEvent
methods.description: Sends a typing indicator event via WebSocket, respecting performance debugging settings.

methods.name: emitUserLoggedOutEvent
methods.description: Handles user logout process, clearing session data, signaling logout to desktop app, and redirecting.

methods.name: toggleSideBarRightMenuAction
methods.description: Closes sidebars and menus related to the right-hand side panel.

methods.name: emitBrowserFocus
methods.description: Dispatches action indicating browser window focus change.

methods.name: getTeamRedirectChannelIfIsAccesible
methods.description: Fetches a team channel accessible to the user, with fallback to default or redirected channels.

methods.name: redirectUserToDefaultTeam
methods.description: Redirects user to their default team and channel, loading data as needed.
